description: Source code for the ue_repository class managing user equipment (UE) contexts in a scheduler, including UE addition, removal, reconfiguration, and slot indication handling.

classes.name: ue_repository
classes.description: Manages UE contexts, including their addition, removal, reconfiguration, and slot-based updates.

methods.name: is_ue_ready_for_removal
methods.description: Checks if a UE has no active HARQ processes and is safe to remove.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot updates, processes UE removals scheduled for the current slot, and updates UE and cell states.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell repository to the UE repository.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell repository from the UE repository.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE with specified configuration and initializes associated components.

methods.name: reconfigure_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures an existing UE based on new configuration data.

methods.name: ue_config_applied
methods.description: Marks a UE as having applied its configuration, exiting fallback mode.

methods.name: schedule_ue_rem
methods.description: Schedules a UE for removal after a delay, considering pending PDUs.

methods.name: get_ues_with_pending_newtx_data
methods.description: Retrieves UEs with pending data for a given slice and direction.

methods.name: find_by_rnti
methods.description: Finds a UE by its RNTI.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE and cleans up associated resources.

methods.name: handle_cell_deactivation
methods.description: Handles deactivation of a cell and removes associated UEs.
